game: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
data_notes: Fields not present in the supplied source are omitted. An attack value of null means the source did not state one. Original source terminology and strategic notes are retained in English.

categories.name: 1h Swords
categories.description: Generally speaking, this is the best weapon to use for a tanking character as Auto-Parry ability requires you have a 1h sword anyway.

weapons.name: Leon’s Sword
weapons.notes: Comes equipped on Leon at the start of the game. This is the sword used to attack enemies in the field to trigger surprise attacks.

weapons.name: Goblin Sword
weapons.notes: Probably the first weapon with a unique tech. Final Strike destroys the weapon to do a low-potency STR-based attack; the source recommends never using it.

weapons.name: Wym Slayer
weapons.tech_details: MAG-based attack against all enemies for 12 potency. An early AoE option for a 1h sword user.
weapons.notes: The source says this is a mistranslation of the original Japanese name, “Worm Slayer”.

weapons.name: Splasher
weapons.tech_details: Attempts to instant kill the target.

weapons.name: Blazing Sword
weapons.tech_details: MAG-dependent damage, potency 24.

techniques.name: Windwolf Blade
techniques.details: Wind aligned, MAG-dependent damage, no range limit.

techniques.name: Dragonfang Blade
techniques.details: Water aligned, MAG-dependent damage; only sparks from Windwolf Blade.

weapons.name: Spectral Sword
weapons.tech_details: HP Drain [Logic + Sword Aptitude LV / 2) > 18], no range limit. Can also be used by Soul Saber once sparked.
weapons.location: Dropped by Dullahan enemies in the Floating Castle.

weapons.name: Butterfly Sword
weapons.location: Defeat Phantom Wagnas in 5 turns or less.

categories.name: Greatswords / 2h Swords
categories.description: These do more damage than 1h swords, but shields will never proc while attacking and Auto-Parry will not trigger. The source advises tanks not to use these.

weapons.name: Exorciser
weapons.tech_details: Damage based on MAG and Reason; the source says only the Diviner class can effectively use it.

weapons.name: Bastard Sword
weapons.notes: Can use both 1h sword and 2h sword techs.

weapons.name: Legendary Plover
weapons.tech_details: Learned from Smash. MAG-dependent and cannot be countered.

weapons.name: Trinity Edge
weapons.tech_details: Potency 24; single-target Range damage.

techniques.name: Pesticide Blade
techniques.details: STR-based attack with critical damage against insect-type enemies.

techniques.name: Killing Blade
techniques.details: STR-based attack that can instantly kill Humanoid enemies; only sparks from Pesticide Blade.

weapons.name: Hauteclaire
weapons.location: Only drops from the Guardian at the Eirunep Shrine entrance.

weapons.name: Dayblade
weapons.location: Comes equipped on Final Emperor M.
weapons.notes: Once acquired, Holy Buster can also use Holy Light. Formerly exclusive to Male Final Emperor, now available to both genders. Only Male Emperor can reforge it.

weapons.name: Moonlite
weapons.location: Comes equipped on Final Emperor F.
weapons.notes: Allows both 1h sword and Greatsword techs. Formerly exclusive to Male Final Emperor, now available to both genders. Only Female Emperor can reforge it.

weapons.name: Crimson Dragon
weapons.tech_details: Potency 51, single target; described as the strongest Greatsword attack.
weapons.location: Dropped by Phantom Noel in post-game for defeating him in under 5 turns.
weapons.notes: Requires high challenge rating to learn and must be sparked against enemies in Dreadhome.

categories.name: Short swords
categories.description: Often translated as Foils. Damage is primarily DEX-based, with exceptions such as Matador, a STR-based counter-attack.

weapons.name: Lob Omen
weapons.tech_details: Potency 36, circle; destroys the weapon. The source says not to use it.

other_techs.name: Mad Biter
other_techs.details: Dark aligned; inflicts Berserk (Madness), effectively Silence because it prevents tech and spell use. The source notes strategic boss uses.

weapons.name: Cutlass
weapons.notes: Can use both 1h sword and shortsword techs.

weapons.name: Specter sword
weapons.notes: Has Suction on it which Soul Saber uses.

weapons.name: Soul Saber
weapons.tech_details: LP Drain, effectively instant death for enemies; does not work on Undead.
weapons.notes: Can use Suction after it is sparked from Specter Sword. The source describes Life Steal as allowing characters to recover their own LP.

weapons.name: Red Quartz Rod
weapons.tech_details: Party HP restoration, potency 50, Berserk to party, and revives 1 ally.
weapons.location: Dropped by Gold Dragons in Nivel Ruins.

weapons.name: Star of Illorina
weapons.tech_details: May instant-kill; cannot be countered.

weapons.name: Terra Blade
weapons.notes: Reforged Estoc requiring 1 Avalonia. Allows wielder to cast fusion spell Elixir.

weapons.name: Temptation Blade
weapons.tech_details: Potency 25; damages all foes and may inflict Charm.
weapons.location: Defeat Phantom Rocbouquet in less than 5 turns during post-game.

categories.name: Axes
categories.description: These are 1h weapons usable with a shield. Axe techs are generally more powerful than 1h sword techs.

weapons.name: Lady Hawk
weapons.tech_details: Gives Mist Cover: turns the character invisible and unable to be targeted.
weapons.notes: Recommended by the source for a character with Fire school aptitude who should use Mist Cover.

weapons.name: Tourmaline Axe
weapons.tech_details: Wind aligned.

weapons.name: Vorpal Axe
weapons.tech_details: Attempts to instant-kill all enemies; cannot be countered.

weapons.name: Amethyst Axe
weapons.notes: The source calls this one of the best weapons due to Phantom Chivalry, despite its attack value. The skill creates a duplicate of the character when cast; it can only use Amethyst Axe attacks and retains prior buffs such as Dragon Pulse. The described strategy is to use Mist Cover while stacking Dragon Pulses, then cast Phantom Chivalry so the clone keeps the boosted stats. The source says it can enable one-turn boss kills if exploited correctly.

weapons.name: Destroyer
weapons.tech_details: STR-based attack hitting surrounding enemies (Pwr 3, BL dmg); powerful and cannot be countered.
weapons.location: Special weapon gained by defeating Dantarg in his final berserk form after losing to him and letting him kill dungeon bosses.

weapons.name: Zircon Axe
weapons.notes: Reforged Great Axe requiring 1 Avalonia. Allows fusion spell Fire Wall. In prior versions it allowed Crimson Flare.

weapons.name: Dragonscale Axe
weapons.tech_details: Potency 48, single target, STR-based and Light aligned; described as the strongest axe attack.

categories.name: Clubs
categories.description: Maces, clubs and staffs. These are 1h weapons usable with a shield. Their techs tend to focus more on debuffs than damage; some unique techs provide powerful buffs for end-game strategies.

weapons.name: Quarterstaff
weapons.tech_details: BP cost 6; chance to paralyze all enemies. Described as a strong early debuff that can work on some early bosses.
weapons.notes: Can be obtained early by adding a Mage for Hire M to the party, or bought after Gen IV from most shops.

weapons.name: Skull Rod
weapons.tech_details: STR-based potency 45 attack against all enemies; permanently destroys the weapon. The source advises against using it.

weapons.name: Sledgehammer
weapons.notes: Heavy Club, so Grand Slam deals extra damage.
weapons.location: Dropped by “Nightmare” in Gelid Ruins, described as the horse-headed minotaur.

other_techs.name: Enhance Spells
other_techs.details: Increases a selected party member's MAG by [Club LV /6]+2; cannot stack with itself. Described as part of end-game strategy builds.

weapons.name: Comroonian Hammer
weapons.tech_details: Earth aligned; deals extra damage to the rock at the top of Mt. Comroon during the Salamander rescue quest.

weapons.name: Liberty Staff

other_techs.name: Blessing
other_techs.details: Raises STR & MAG by [Club Aptitude LV / 6]+2; does not stack with itself. Can stack with bonus STR from Berserk and Dragon Pulse.

weapons.notes: Shatter Rod permanently destroys the weapon and only heals the party for 10 potency. The source says not to use it.

weapons.name: Silver Hammer
weapons.tech_details: Critical damage against Beastmen. The source says the English localization tooltip is wrong.

weapons.name: Ruby Rod
weapons.notes: Boosts stats by your HP level.

weapons.name: Holy Buster
weapons.notes: After Holy Light has been learned from Dayblade, it becomes available to use on Holy Buster.

weapons.name: Marionette's Club
weapons.tech_details: Potency 42, single target, water aligned; reduces enemy Magic.
weapons.location: Dropped by Phantom Bokhohn for defeating him in less than 5 turns during post-game.

categories.name: Spears
categories.description: Spears are two-handed weapons; a shield will never proc while attacking with them.

weapons.name: Trident
weapons.tech_details: Critical against Aquatic; no range limit; cannot be countered. Can also be used by Ranseur and Poseidon's Spear once sparked.

weapons.name: Gae Bulg
weapons.tech_details: Potency 43; cannot be countered and has no range limit.
weapons.location: Can drop from any dragon boss. The source recommends farming the first Storm dragon at the entrance to Nival Ruins; drop rate is very low. Also described as an excellent mid-game source for farming techs, spells and aptitude.

weapons.name: Lance of Ukom
weapons.notes: Reforged Obsidian Lance requiring 1 Avalonia. Allows fusion spell Cyclone Squeeze.

weapons.name: Nautilus Spear
weapons.tech_details: Potency 50, single target, Light aligned.
weapons.location: Dropped from Phantom Subier after defeating him in less than 5 turns in post-game.

weapons.name: Fail-Not

other_techs.name: Heart Seeker
other_techs.details: Attempts to Charm; the source says Beast Slayer has a chance to spark it.

weapons.notes: The supplied text does not provide an attack value or an explicit location.

weapons.name: Grim Reaper
weapons.tech_details: Attempts to instant-kill all enemies.
weapons.location: Gelid Ruins; described as easy to obtain early, in the same place as Amethyst Axe.

weapons.name: Starlight Bow
weapons.notes: Learned from Rain of Arrows. The AoE attack lands at the end of a turn.

weapons.name: Eris’ Bow
weapons.notes: Allows use of fusion spell Heatwave.
weapons.location: Forged by the Smithy and can be obtained fairly early.

weapons.name: Soulreaper Bow
weapons.tech_details: Absorbs a foe's LP and adds it to the user's pool, allowing characters to recover lost LP without Darkstone or LP potions. Does not drain LP from undead enemies.
weapons.notes: Life Steal has a reversed effect for a character using Diviner ability Umbral Benison: it depletes the user's LP instead. A character with Undying cannot recover LP with it either.
weapons.location: Defeat Phantom Kzinssie in 5 turns or less.
